subject.title: [Feature]: When messages are merged and processed, the agent event is expected to carry the original runId(s)

question: Should Gateway agent/chat events grow an additive lineage field for collect/merged turns, and what exact name and semantics should that field use?
rationale: Current source tracks queued identities internally but exposes only singular public run IDs on an M4 stable Gateway contract, so automation should not choose the API semantics unilaterally.

options.title: Add additive lineage array
options.body: Preserve the executed `runId` and add a named array such as `sourceRunIds` or `originalRunIds` for merged queued sources.

options.title: Reuse one source ID
options.body: Make merged execution appear under the first or last queued source ID, simplifying some clients while hiding multi-source lineage and changing run identity semantics.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Document that clients must correlate through accepted/final events and history, accepting that live aggregate agent events do not expose every queued source.

recommendation.title: Add additive lineage array
recommendation.body: Preserve the executed `runId` and add a named array such as `sourceRunIds` or `originalRunIds` for merged queued sources.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the stable Gateway event contract and recent history routes the relevant protocol/projection surface most strongly here.
